title: HDB Rental Flats for Displaced and Homeless Individuals
what_it_is: HDB Rental Flats for Displaced and Homeless Individuals

sections.label: MSF assistance for homeless individuals
sections.summary: MSF-assisted individuals often sought help from relatives or the open market, and about half applied for rental flats, with about half succeeding.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Some of them had sold their flat due to debt or divorce, or could not continue staying with their families because of strained relationships or behavioural issues.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: They would often first approach close relatives or friends to take them in or rent from the open market, intermittently for a few days or up to several months.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Of these cases assisted by MSF, about half applied for a rental flat, of which about half were successful.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Those who were unsuccessful mostly had other housing options when they applied, such as being able to afford a flat or having family support.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: HDB, MSF and social service agencies would work together to assist these individuals and families to explore alternative housing options.

sections.label: Temporary shelter with social agencies
sections.summary: MSF works with social service agencies to identify temporary shelter options for families and individuals with no other place to stay.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For some families and individuals who have no other place to stay, MSF works with social service agencies to identify temporary shelter options while they find other accommodation.

sections.label: Unanswered question on displacement measures
sections.summary: The Parliamentary Secretary has not answered part (c) on measures with HDB to flag potential displacement and homeless cases at rental flat application.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: One is that the Parliamentary Secretary has not answered part (c) of my question, which is: what are some of the measures that the Ministry has with HDB to flag out potential displacement and homeless cases at the point of application for a rental flat?

sections.label: No comment on homelessness trend
sections.summary: The speaker is unable to comment on the homelessness trend.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: On the homelessness trend, I am unable to comment on this.
